cta_summary.orientation: The weather code keeps a copy in memory, so the page stays fast when the network is slow.

tier_3_terminology_cards.concise_definition: A copy kept close so the next read is fast.
tier_3_terminology_cards.try_first: Why would a program keep a copy of something it could fetch again?
tier_3_terminology_cards.contrast_anchor: Unlike a backup, a cache can be thrown away.

annotations.why: Every caller gets the same dict.

tier_2_self_explanation_cards.front_prompt: What breaks if two requests fetch at once?
tier_2_self_explanation_cards.back_explanation: Both write the copy; one overwrites the other.

key_ideas: Two requests can run at the same moment.
preread.try_first: What happens when two people edit one note at once?
